scope: All identified accessible developed changes compared with existing source; obsolete versions retained in their origin branches. Other unavailable private workspaces cannot be claimed recovered.
apk_acceptance: Pending exact-source GitHub APK build and real Android emulator tour. Local source tests do not certify an APK or physical-device performance.

legacy_prototype_audit.coverage: Developed core modules compared with accessible earlier reports and executable HTML prototypes. Writing trainer, journal, profiles and writing progress remain byte-identical to the 2080 baseline.
legacy_prototype_audit.recovered_feature: Direct dictation of a custom task in the recognition screen, using the existing speech service and confirmation flow.
legacy_prototype_audit.excluded_claims: Static unexecuted MVPs, future briefs and the old photo-OCR demo/stub are not evidence of completed missing features. No claim of line-for-line reuse of obsolete versions.
